## Description

Prove exit criteria: contract+handoff, ## Proof skills, execute assembly+aff+incidental, dashboard Proof UI, and an integration smoke that creates a proof-packet at a SHA and surfaces Look via adaptive-artifacts / dashboard model.

## Approach

Re-run the phase check commands scoped to this phase's tests, then run tests/test_proof_packet_smoke.py which uses the public adaptive-artifacts CLI against a disposable store (or the live type once present) and dashboard.model.load_phase_detail.
